member.name: T:OpenPass.TlvRequestCallbackType
member.summary: requestResponse completion metadata 中的回调类型。

member.name: T:OpenPass.TlvRequestFrameSpec
member.summary: Generated binding 传给 frame builder 的 request 输入。 requestMessageId + requestRootPlan + requestRootEncoder 必须成组出现： messageId 决定 JS 路由，plan 决定 root/external buffer 布局，encoder 必须按同一份 plan 写入 root。 frame builder 再把这组输入和 receiverToken 组装成 TlvCallFrameHeader + root + external descriptor table。

member.name: T:OpenPass.ITlvPendingCompletion
member.summary: 共用 callback token 注册表和 completion batch；不同 API 只负责解码各自的终结 payload。

member.name: T:OpenPass.TlvPendingRequestCompletion
member.summary: requestResponse completion pending callback。 JS side waits for complete before sending one callback batch frame back to C#; C# then releases the full callback token after that batch. Generated subclasses hold typed callbacks and decode success / fail / complete payloads directly, so token lookup is enough to dispatch. expectedCompletionMessageId is kept only for protocol validation after token lookup; it does not route callbacks or choose payload codecs.

member.name: P:OpenPass.TlvPendingRequestCompletion.TerminalCallbackType
member.summary: JS 回包携带的成功或失败标记，供 complete 联合类型选择对应的解码器。

member.name: T:OpenPass.TlvTaskPendingRequestCompletion
member.summary: 将 managerObject 的 Promise 方法（如广告 load/show）的 TLV completion 转为 C# Task。 复用基类的完整 callback token 路由和 success/fail/complete 分发；这里只负责完成或拒绝 Task， 供生成的 *Async API 返回给调用方 await，不另建请求通道。

member.name: T:OpenPass.TlvRequestCompletionBatch
member.summary: JS -> C# requestResponse callback batch root。 root layout is bridge-internal, not business schema TLV. The completion messageId identifies this as a callback batch. [terminalCallbackType:uint16][padding:uint16][terminalRootBytes:uint32][completeRootBytes:uint32][padding:uint32] followed by terminal root bytes, then complete root bytes, padded to layout-word alignment. terminalCallbackType is None / Success / Fail; complete is always present and dispatched after terminal.
